<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1000 1000">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="1000" height="1000" fill="#ffffff"/>

  <text x="100" y="65" fill="#17212b" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="28">Steady two-dimensional heat conduction</text>
  <text x="100" y="103" fill="#17212b" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="21">∇²T = 0     Plate: 1 × 0.6</text>

  <g data-field="T" data-status="ill-posed">
    <text x="100" y="158" fill="#a32920" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="22">Exact boundary specification is inconsistent at the lower corners.</text>
    <text x="100" y="192" fill="#17212b" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18">At (0,0) and (1,0), the bottom requires 100 °C while the sides require 0 °C.</text>
    <text x="100" y="222" fill="#17212b" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18">No temperature field can satisfy both prescribed corner values exactly.</text>

    <text x="100" y="269" fill="#17212b" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18">Requested isotherms — not drawn under the contradictory specification:</text>

    <path data-level="10" d="" fill="none" stroke="#246580"/>
    <text x="100" y="303" fill="#246580" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="19">10 °C</text>
    <path data-level="20" d="" fill="none" stroke="#246580"/>
    <text x="255" y="303" fill="#246580" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="19">20 °C</text>
    <path data-level="40" d="" fill="none" stroke="#246580"/>
    <text x="410" y="303" fill="#246580" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="19">40 °C</text>
    <path data-level="60" d="" fill="none" stroke="#246580"/>
    <text x="565" y="303" fill="#246580" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="19">60 °C</text>
    <path data-level="80" d="" fill="none" stroke="#246580"/>
    <text x="720" y="303" fill="#246580" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="19">80 °C</text>

    <text x="100" y="348" fill="#525d66" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="17">Excluding the lower corners from the boundary conditions would permit</text>
    <text x="100" y="373" fill="#525d66" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="17">the usual harmonic solution with discontinuous corner limits.</text>
  </g>

  <rect x="100" y="420" width="800" height="480" fill="#f7f9fa" stroke="#17212b" stroke-width="3"/>
  <line x1="100" y1="900" x2="900" y2="900" stroke="#b73528" stroke-width="5"/>

  <text x="500" y="409" fill="#17212b" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="20" text-anchor="middle">T = 0 °C</text>
  <text x="65" y="660" fill="#17212b" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="20" text-anchor="middle" transform="rotate(-90 65 660)">T = 0 °C</text>
  <text x="931" y="660" fill="#17212b" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="20" text-anchor="middle" transform="rotate(90 931 660)">T = 0 °C</text>
  <text x="500" y="935" fill="#b73528" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="21" text-anchor="middle">T = 100 °C</text>

  <text x="120" y="453" fill="#525d66" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="17">(0, 0.6)</text>
  <text x="880" y="453" fill="#525d66" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="17" text-anchor="end">(1, 0.6)</text>
  <text x="120" y="876" fill="#525d66" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="17">(0, 0)</text>
  <text x="880" y="876" fill="#525d66" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="17" text-anchor="end">(1, 0)</text>

  <circle cx="100" cy="900" r="9" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#a32920" stroke-width="3"/>
  <circle cx="900" cy="900" r="9" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#a32920" stroke-width="3"/>
  <text x="500" y="659" fill="#525d66" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="21" text-anchor="middle">Plate domain</text>
  <text x="500" y="691" fill="#525d66" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" text-anchor="middle">Lower-corner conflicts marked by circles</text>

  <g fill="none" stroke="#69747d" stroke-width="1.5">
    <line x1="100" y1="921" x2="100" y2="979"/>
    <line x1="900" y1="921" x2="900" y2="979"/>
    <line x1="100" y1="967" x2="900" y2="967"/>
    <line x1="94" y1="973" x2="106" y2="961"/>
    <line x1="894" y1="973" x2="906" y2="961"/>
    <line x1="910" y1="420" x2="982" y2="420"/>
    <line x1="918" y1="900" x2="982" y2="900"/>
    <line x1="970" y1="420" x2="970" y2="900"/>
    <line x1="964" y1="426" x2="976" y2="414"/>
    <line x1="964" y1="906" x2="976" y2="894"/>
  </g>
  <text x="500" y="989" fill="#525d66" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="17" text-anchor="middle">1</text>
  <text x="989" y="660" fill="#525d66" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="17" text-anchor="middle" transform="rotate(-90 989 660)">0.6</text>
</svg>
